description: This is an HTML source file implementing the front-end interface of a database viewer application. It includes structure, styling, and client-side scripting to load, display, and interact with database and table data via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data table with provided data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
